guideline: Reducing daily salt intake to less than 5 grams (about one teaspoon) can significantly lower blood pressure. Avoid processed foods which are often high in sodium.
source: WHO Guideline on Sodium Intake for Adults and Children

guideline: Aim for at least 150 minutes of moderate-intensity aerobic activity, such as brisk walking, cycling, or dancing, each week.
source: WHO Global Recommendations on Physical Activity for Health

guideline: Eat a balanced diet rich in fruits, vegetables, and whole grains. Limit the intake of foods high in saturated fats, trans fats, and sugar.
source: The Gambia National Guidelines for NCDs

guideline: Regularly check your blood pressure as advised by a healthcare professional. Keeping a log can help your doctor manage your condition effectively.
source: Hypertension Prevention and Control Manual - The Gambia
